notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara launches on September 15th 17:00 CET! 🎉
notes.content:
Global release on Steam is here! 


To celebrate, the game will launch with a special discount. We’ve made the adventure a bit shorter than we have planned, and adjusted the price so it perfectly matches the content — delivering the best Stream-Bara experience at a fair value. 


But that's not all! To celebrate the release, we’re hosting the very first Speedrun Tournament! 


When: 15.09.2025, 20:00 CET → 21.09.2025, 20:00 CET  

 Challenge: Beat Chapter 2 as fast as you can! Unlimited attempts within the event time. 



 Prizes: 
[olist]
 Custom Stream-Bara skin (your design!) + CAPPA T-shirt 

 CAPPA T-shirt 

 CAPPA cap  
[/olist]


To join the tournament, and to see more details about it,  sign up here: 

https://forms.gle/t15cZuwugpCySDri6  


Have fun!

notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara: Demo Update – Next Fest Developer Showcase! 🎉
notes.content:
This time, things are getting extra crunchy with a brand-new demo update debuting just in time for Steam Next Fest.
What’s New in the Demo?
Story and NPCs have been reworked. Be sure to check out every secret!

Emotes! Player can now send emotes to each other!

Private rooms. You can now create and join private games. Perfect for a playthrough with friends or... a stream with your favourite creator!

Voting effects rebalanced. Those should be more impactful now.

Bunch of small fixes and improvements.
Don’t miss your chance to dive snout-first into the weirdest streamer adventure of the year.

notes.title: Super Stream-Bara Demo Update - version 0.04
notes.content:
Version 0.04 Changelog:


 Demo split into two parts: Chapter 1 & Nightmare (Nightmare offers harder levels),
 Story rework (new npc - evil ghost!),
 New feature: Emotes! Players can now send each other emojis,
 Voting effects balanced so they appear less, but are more impactful,
 New voting animation that show exactly who's voting on what effect,
 Private rooms,
 Game UI reworked,
 Various bugfixes and improvements
